title: SoS: Analysis of Surface-over-Semantics in Multilingual Text-To-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a novel Surface-over-Semantics (SoS) score using image embeddings to quantify whether a generated image aligns more with the average representation of the prompt's input language (surface form) or its actual semantic meaning.

Prompting models with 171 distinct cultural identities and analyzing the outputs by using Visual Question Answering (VQA) combined with the Fighting Words method to identify stereotypical visual attributes, which are then compared against the SeeGULL stereotype dataset.

Aggregating and comparing SoS scores across generated images prompted with male, female, and neutral person terms to identify intersectional variations and biases between gender and specific prompt languages/cultures.
